step-1.note: The hidden text is published in GitHub Markdown. The record is the raw issue, pull request, comment, or README, not the rendered page.

step-2.note: A project agent that reads the raw item receives the hidden text. Reading it is not the same as following it. The paper does not publish a production tool log.

step-3.note: The replay was offline, one response each, with mock tools. It is not a deployed victim session.

step-4.note: The orchestration markers are public comments. A marker that records an approval is still text until a workflow acts on it. The paper does not show that action.
